content: Juan Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igargi Jesús-ogsad-sorbali, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled, Jesús nia-sailase-wilubdaklegega, nega-dulesulidganba Jesús-sessunnad.
Jesús Bab-Dummadse-golegala, iba-dulabogus (40) mutikidba, degi, ibginedba mas-gunsuli gudii gusad. A-sorba, ukur itoalid.
Degi, nia-saila-emar-wilubdaked ese nonikid, ega sognonikid: —Ar be Bab-Dummad-Machi-sunnadiile, we-akwamarga be soge: ‘Maduga be binyeye.’
Jesús, nia-saila-abin sogded: —Noar be soged. Ar Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar maid:
Deuteronomio 8:3
Geb degi, nia-saila Jerusalén-neggwebur-islidikidse Jesús-sesad. Agi Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-uas-birgi ogwisdapgu,
Jesúsʼga sogded: —Ar be Bab-Dummad-Machi-sunnadiile, be napase ichomakdo. Ar Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar maid:
Jesús, nia-saila-abin sogded: —Nabir be sogendo. Ar Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar maibalid:
Deuteronomio 6:16
Geb degi gannar nia-saila yar-matusulidse Jesús-sesbalid. Agi belagwable napa-naid, degi, e-gangumalad ese oyosgu,
Jesúsʼga sogded: —An-nug-odummogega be sindigar an-asabin sigele, geb we-ibmar belagwapa an bega ukoed.
Geb degi, Jesús, abin-sogded: —Nia-saila-Satanás, be angi bangu. Ar Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar maid:
Deuteronomio 6:13
Geb degi, nia-saila Jesúsʼgi bangussunnad. A-sorba, baliwiturmar Jesúsʼse nonikid, ega ibmar imaknonimalad.
Jesús e-arbaedgi onoded
Jesús itoargu, Diigi-dule-oged-Juan esgaryagi mellesiiye, Jesús gannar Galilea-yarse nonikid.
Nazaret-neggweburgi-maid bangudgu, Capernaúm-neggweburgi megnonikid. We-neggwebur, Zabulón-yar-naidgi, degi, Neftalí-yar-naidgi mata-dummad-naid-walik siid.
Ar epenne Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Isaías-sogsagusadba-guegala, deyob gunonikid. Deun sogsagusgu:
Isaías 9:1-2
Degi, agi Jesús Bab-Dummad-gayaburbagi sunmakarsunnad. Weyob sogded: “Ar Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid bemarse warmaksad. Degisoggu, be-isgudiidga na be bukib binsamar. Be-daed na be ogwamar.”
Jesús ua-gamalad-warbakegwadse gochad

Jesús Galilea-mata-dummad-gakaba nadapgu, dule e-urba-ebo mata-dummadgi saki-minai dakalid. Gwensak Simónʼye nugad. A-dule, Pedroʼye nugbalid. E-urbadi, Andrésʼye nugad. Amarde gusgu ua-gaedgi arbamaladid.
Jesús amarga sogded: —Anba be dagmar. Igi bemar ua-gae, deyobi, dulemar-anba-nagumalaga, dulemar-gaega an be-imakmaloed.
Simón, degi, Andrés, e-saki abga yog-indakar imaksamalad, Jesúsʼba yog-naar imaksamalad.
Jesús sikwas nadbargu, Jacobo, e-urba-Juanʼbo, urgi e-bab-Zebedeoʼmala saki-matumakbukwa dakdapid. Jesús, eba-dagega, e-sapinganga-guega, amar-ebogwadse gochamogad.
Amar, Jesúsʼba-naegala, yog ur-mete, degi, e-bab-Zebedeo-mete nadmalad.
Jesús dulemar-bukidar-nudaksad

Jesús bela Galilea-yargi, Judíoʼmar-onmakedneggi dulemar-odurdakdii gusad, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid-gayaburba-nuedgi sunmakdii gusad. Degine, bela dule-uellemalad, degi, galagwensuli ibmar-nunmak-itomalad-nudakdii gusad.

Jesús dulemar-nudakdiidba, bela Siria-yalase e-nug dunguded. A-ular, dulemar bela ibmar-naibi-itodimalad, galagwensuli-gegudimalad, abagan-nunmakdimalad, niasamalad, suu-itodimalad, abagan-burgwarmalad, Jesúsʼse senonimalad. Bela Jesús amar-nudaksad.
